While John Muir College does not call for the completion of a minor to fulfill its requirements for the degree of bachelor of arts or bachelor of science, it does acknowledge the completion of an approved departmental minor on a student’s transcript. No upper-division courses may be used to satisfy both a major and a minor. For a minor, students are required to complete a minimum of twenty-eight units of interrelated work, of which at least twenty units must be upper-division.
